build_policy.build_authorization: root separately authorizes one isolated release build after quality

candidate_change.description: Replace NsReader transport in validation.rs and raw worksheet codec with Reader events plus borrowed NamespaceResolver resolution; pending-scope pops and all existing validation remain authoritative.

comparison.allocator_statistic: descriptive median of three paired screening repeats
comparison.native_statistic: descriptive median of six paired screening legs
comparison.pairing: adjacent A/B or B/A within each frozen block; native and allocator lanes never pair
comparison.role_B: 0964 raw-reader and NamespaceResolver transport candidate executable

confirmation.allocator: fresh three AB/BA repeats, 2 warmups, 10 samples per child
confirmation.native: fresh six ABBA/BAAB blocks, 20 warmups, 200 samples per child
confirmation.when: only after qualifying screen signal and every safety, source, terminal, control, and oracle gate passes

controls.candidate_specific_tests: test-only paths are explicitly bound in candidate_allowlist_file and candidate_change.test_only_allowlist
groups: ordinary full validation and source admission
BOM, EOF/closure, depth/input limits, cancellation and cleanup
measured raw worksheet codec path and deterministic output/inverse
controls.scope: Existing deterministic reader differential and full XLSX quality gates; no separate unbuilt control harness.

epoch2_affinity_hardening.launch_mismatch: fail before wait/report parsing; no retry or replacement

execution.process_group: start_new_session; bounded SIGTERM then SIGKILL; reap and verify clear

gates.confirmation_adoption_gate: fresh confirmation plus named primary <=0.95, bootstrap CI upper <1.0, no safety stop, and all ordinary/fallback/differential/oracle controls pass
gates.hard_safety: native primary, native phase p99, native max_rss_kib, allocator region_peak_live_bytes, or allocator max_rss_kib median >1.05
gates.invalid_metric_or_oracle: reject packet and stop without retry
tail_resource_guards: all required p99 values finite and positive
allocator phase live boundaries and combined conservation exact
allocator resources_after_core all zero and failed allocations zero
gates.useful_signal: native edit_commit_ns.p50/p95, total_ns.p50/p95, native max_rss_kib, or allocator region_peak_live_bytes median <=0.95

purpose: Prospective descriptive screen of a bounded XLSX NsReader-to-Reader/NamespaceResolver transport change; screen cannot authorize adoption.

quality.scope: full XLSX quality plus frozen reader differential; source verified after quality before candidate freeze

allocator.allocation_scope: global system-allocator callbacks serialized by allocation_metrics; process-wide across threads; observer peaks are not RSS, unique heap, per-thread bytes, OS-thread counts, or timing
allocator.performance_claim: none; allocator counters do not claim latency, throughput, RSS, OS-thread width, worker/task overlap, speedup, or adoption; procfs Threads values are quiescence observations only
allocator.scope: process-wide serialized allocator regions with exact phase conservation; no latency or adoption claim

native.performance_claim: none; raw phase timings describe this explicit in-memory harness and do not claim OS thread counts, speedup, allocation behavior, or physical I/O
native.scope: timed in-memory phase report with source/output/semantic/resource oracles outside timers

reused_0959.reuse_policy: import only nearest-rank/geometric-mean/ratio/bootstrap after exact SHA validation; all schedule and sample validation is 0964-specific

root_screen_selector_controls.description: synthetic equality, invalid, no-signal, safety-stop, and counter-only controls

scope.allocator_schedule: 3 paired AB/BA/AB repeats, 2 warmups, 10 measured rows, 18 serial fresh-process children
scope.candidate_mechanism: raw Reader plus borrowed NamespaceResolver transport in two measured worksheet loops
scope.native_schedule: 3 blocks ABBA/BAAB/ABBA, 10 warmups, 60 measured samples, 36 serial fresh-process children

source.source_cache_state: fresh process and in-memory OwnedSource; no cold filesystem claim

status_note: Fresh candidate custody and root bindings supplied; measurements remain false until capture authorization.
